messages:
maria: kicking off region-by-region rollout for v2.4.1 — slices US -> EU -> APAC. pinned image: `redwood/inference:v2.4.1`

deploy-bot: 🚀 starting canary in us-west-2 (slice 1/6) at 2024-05-03T14:47:48Z (thread 1715002468)

kevin: noted. queuing capacity checks for each region — running `deployctl capacity check --region=us-west-2 --slice=1` now

aj: quick reminder — EU change window opens in 2h, APAC in 5h. keep canaries small for EU until we see latency stability.

ops-bot: capacity-check report (us-west-2, slice 1):
  - healthy nodes: 18
  - avg GPU util: 62%
  - tail latency p95: 320ms
  - warm-pool reserve: 4 gpus
  => OK for 10% canary

maria: thanks. launching EU canary only after us steady for 15m. keep rollback criteria: error-rate > 1.5% sustained for 3m OR p95 > 600ms for 5m.

deploy-bot: us-west-2 canary at 10% traffic — 3/3 replicas healthy

leo: seeing slight increase in token-queue depth on one host, spike ~1.2s for a few requests, not systemic. watching.

kevin: re-run capacity check across us-east-1 to ensure cross-az buffer: `deployctl capacity check --region=us-east-1 --min-reserve=3`

ops-bot: capacity-check (us-east-1): healthy nodes 12, avg gpu util 68%, warm-pool 3, eviction headroom 2 -> borderline but acceptable for canary. recommend no additional slices until warm-pool >=4.

maria: ok hold further slices for 12m while we warm additional nodes. status update in 10.

aj: tagging @nora who owns warm-pool autoscale policies — Nora can you kick a pre-warm job for us-east?

nora: on it. running `autoscale warm-pool --region=us-east-1 --target=4 --reason="v2.4.1 canary"` — will update when nodes ready (~6-8m).

deploy-bot: update: us-west-2 canary metrics stable (error-rate 0.4%, p95 330ms). proceeding to expand us slice to 25% per rollout plan.

kevin: after expansion, watch for KV cache miss rate. if miss-rate increases > 12% we pause and pin previous model.

maria: agreed. also adding a soft pin rule: if any region triggers rollback criteria, we pin traffic in other regions to previous stable variant `v2.4.0` until fix/mitigation.

ops-bot: nudge: eu warm-pool available in 1m. ready for EU canary queue.

maria: okay launching EU canary at 5% now. deploy-bot please route EU test traffic only (no realtime customers) for first 10m.

deploy-bot: EU canary started (slice EU-central-1, 5%) — tests routed to canary routing group `canary-eu-20240503`

leo: EU latency p95 ~420ms, error-rate 0.9% — within thresholds but higher than US. investigating model quantization path in EU nodes.

aj: quick check — are EU nodes using the same kernel pack? `runtime-bundle 1.8.2` vs `1.8.1` mismatch leads to perf delta sometimes.

nora: confirmed EU kernel is 1.8.2, US is 1.8.1. I'm spinning an image with 1.8.1 on a test pool to compare.

kevin: hold EU expansion until we confirm kernel parity. minor perf diffs are fine but want consistent baseline.

maria: agreed. pause EU expansion. don't cascade to APAC yet. leaving US at 25% and EU at 5% paused for now.

deploy-bot: EU canary paused by @maria — traffic frozen at 5% (no abort).

ops-bot: autoscale note: spinning down warmed nodes if idle. flagged warm-pool for region eu-central-1 to keep 2 nodes until patch.

leo: comparison job results: EU nodes with runtime-bundle 1.8.1 p95 drops to 370ms — matches US. root cause likely kernel-level schedule/wrapper change in 1.8.2.

nora: rolling EU test pool to 1.8.1 now — `rolling-update runtime-bundle --region=eu-central-1 --version=1.8.1 --parallel=2` (ETA ~7m)

kevin: while that's happening, let's prep rollback steps if needed: checklist in case of rollback ->
  1) `deployctl pin-version --region=<region> --version=v2.4.0`
  2) throttle new traffic via rate-limiter policy `release/fallback`
  3) open incident channel and attach snapshot logs

maria: good checklist. add step to update release notes with rollback reason and link to incident.

deploy-bot: EU runtime-bundle rollback to 1.8.1 completed on test pool. waiting for health probes.

ops-bot: EU canary metrics now: p95 365ms, error-rate 0.6%. Recommend resume EU expansion to 20% in 10m if stable.

maria: resume EU expansion to 20% in 10m. APAC still on hold until EU stable for 30m.

aj: FYI, release notes draft is at https://confluence.redwood.com/releases/v2.4.1 — includes change log, known issues, canary plan, rollback criteria.

leo: running a quick KV cache warm job for EU and US: `cache-warm --model=redwood/inference:v2.4.1 --prefixes-file=sanity_prompts.txt`

deploy-bot: US expanded to 25% (stable), EU expansion to 20% scheduled at 1715003100.

nora: APAC warm pool still behind due to a maintenance window in ap-northeast-1. ops has a manual override to keep warm nodes but need approval due to extra cost.

kevin: approve manual override for APAC warm-pool for next 6h to ensure safe cutover — cc @maria for confirmation.

maria: approved. finance notified for temporary buffer cost. proceed.

ops-bot: final status snapshot at 1715002901:
  - US: 25% traffic to v2.4.1, p95 335ms, errors 0.5%
  - EU: 20% traffic to v2.4.1, p95 368ms, errors 0.7%
  - APAC: 0% (hold), warm-pool prewarming: 3/4 nodes ready
  - pinned fallback: v2.4.0 available in all regions
  - next checkpoint: 1715003700 (30m)

kevin: leaving monitoring alerts on high sensitivity for next 60m. set temporary SLO bump for canary windows.

maria: thanks team. if anything breaches rollback criteria we execute the checklist and notify #incidents. otherwise we'll proceed region-by-region per plan and update this thread. :thumbsup:

aj: ack.

nora: ack — will post when APAC warmed and ready.

leo: monitoring dashboards pinned to the thread for quick review.

deploy-bot: thread closed for automated updates — manual messages still allowed.

maria: closing out here, leaving final deploy notes in confluence and will file a short rollout summary after 1h stable window.
